title: Ginger Johnson wins UK Series 5
summary: In the Grand Finale (UK-S05-E10), Ginger Johnson and Michael Marouli lip-synced to Erasure's "A Little Respect". Ginger Johnson was crowned the winner; Michael Marouli finished as runner-up. Tomara Thomas placed third. Early UK series offered no cash prize.

title: Alexis Saint-Pete: Series 5 Porkchop
summary: Alexis Saint-Pete was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race UK Series 5 (UK-S05-E02), lip-syncing to Tiësto and Charli XCX's "Hot in It" against Miss Naomi Carter. Episode 1 had been a non-elimination premiere with a top-two lip sync for the win.

title: Ginger Johnson's three-win streak
summary: Ginger Johnson won three consecutive maxi challenges across UK-S05-E04 (DisasterClass, shared with Michael Marouli and Tomara Thomas), UK-S05-E05 (Pant-Oh She Better Don't: The Rusical), and UK-S05-E06 (Snatch Game as Dame Barbara Cartland).

title: DeDeLicious survives three lip syncs
summary: DeDeLicious won three consecutive lip syncs for her life — "I Dreamed a Dream" (UK-S05-E05), "Heartbreak on Hold" (UK-S05-E06), and "This Hell" (UK-S05-E08) — before being eliminated in UK-S05-E09 after losing to Tomara Thomas to Annie Lennox's "Little Bird".

title: Series 5 airs amid UK prize scrutiny
summary: Before Series 5 aired, the show faced public criticism that UK contestants receive no cash prize despite the cost of competing. Series 4 winner Danny Beard said they "could have bought a house" with the money spent preparing; Willam also called for the franchise to pay winners. The Series 5 prize remained non-cash.
